reviewer: BA independent reviewer (subagent a648f7528e565ff59 of Claude Code session d0ec1166-ffc9-446a-ba86-d768242e6de8, model claude-opus-5-5)
allowed_inputs: .migration-tmp/stage-02/phase-a (sparse worktree at the reviewed revision): instruction files listed in the routing extract and legacy/
disclosed_exposure: Client-injected gitStatus snapshot and commit subject lines plus neutral CLAUDE.md bridge at launch; not requested; no record content (accepted by PM ANSWER BA-002-01).
method: WAR extracted with C:/Windows/System32/tar.exe into .migration-tmp/stage-02/reviewer-scratch/war. Descriptors parsed with an own non-validating XML parser (xmlmini.js); 594 class files parsed with an own class-file parser (classparse.js: constant pool, fields, methods, annotations, invoke/field/ldc operands); JSPs scanned with comment-stripping regexes (jsp-enum.js) and read selectively. No decompiler, no JDK, no runtime. Negative findings were checked with a positive control on the same pattern. Class evidence is cited by symbol, shipped files by line.

status_vocabulary.confirmed-static: directly shown by a shipped descriptor/JSP or by bytecode constants and call references
status_vocabulary.inferred: runtime consequence reasoned from static evidence; not observed

coverage_limits: Method bodies were not decompiled: control flow and branch order are inferred from constants and call references; such items are marked inferred.
JSPs were read selectively; every JSP is listed in appendix.jsp with its forms, permission tags and links, but not every label/column was inventoried.
Third-party jar internals were not analysed beyond names/versions and a template search.
No runtime observation (Stage 3); every runtime consequence is at most inferred.
ResourceBundle texts are cited by key, not by translated text.
exclusions: legacy/demo-seed.sql: prepared demo fixture, not behaviour evidence (authorized scope); only its first 1500 bytes were read to confirm its nature.

items.title: Legacy package content and identity
items.behavior: legacy/ holds README.md, docker-compose.yml, demo-seed.sql (prepared demo fixture; not behaviour evidence) and xplanner-plus.war. The WAR is XPlanner+ version 1.1a4, build revision 426, build date 04/12/2011, Maven artifact net.sf:xplanner-plus:1.1, built with JDK 1.6.0_29.
items.limits: demo-seed.sql excluded as behaviour evidence per authorized scope

items.title: Known local MySQL configuration patch and its location
items.behavior: The effective configuration points at MySQL jdbc:mysql://db/xplanner with dialect XPlannerMySQLDialect in BOTH xplanner.properties and the loaded override xplanner-custom.properties. README says the patched file is xplanner-custom.properties; the docker-compose comment says xplanner.properties. spring-beans.xml dataSource also carries a MySQL-specific defaultAutoCommit=false with a comment about the login module changePassword. Which of these lines are upstream and which are the local patch cannot be separated from the package alone.
items.limits: Upstream original not available; patch boundary unverified

items.title: Local run helper (not part of upstream)
items.behavior: docker-compose runs MySQL 5.7 (db, database/user xplanner) and Tomcat 9 on JRE 8 (port 8080) with -Xverify:none; the WAR is mounted as xplanner-legacy.war, so the context path is /xplanner-legacy. README states http://localhost:8080/xplanner-plus and default login sysadmin/admin. The WAR itself declares /xplanner-plus (META-INF/context.xml, sun-web.xml) and /xplanner (geronimo-web.xml).

items.title: WAR file composition
items.behavior: 964 files: 594 classes (WEB-INF/classes), 102 jars (WEB-INF/lib), 73 JSPs plus 1 tag file and 2 HTML fragments, 24 .properties, descriptor XML, 10 TLDs, static images/css/js/calendar/flash, two import templates (files/peopleImportTemplate.xls, files/storiesImportTemplate.xls) and a shipped activity log file. Exhaustive lists in appendix.jsp, appendix.jars, appendix.warFiles.

items.title: Web UI channel: Struts 1.2.9 under /do/*
items.behavior: XPlannerActionServlet (Struts ActionServlet subclass using Spring message source) is mapped to /do/*; it loads struts-config.xml, mobile-struts-config.xml and test-struts-config.xml; actions are delegated to Spring beans by path (DelegatingTilesRequestProcessor, ContextLoaderPlugIn loading action-servlet.xml, spring-beans.xml, test-action-servlet.xml). 74 actions in struts-config.xml (exhaustive list in appendix.strutsActions).

items.title: Mobile/WAP channel under /do/mobile/*
items.behavior: 7 actions: /mobile/login and read-only views of projects, project, iteration, story, task, person rendered from WEB-INF/jsp/wap/*.jsp.

items.title: Test/diagnostic action set loaded in the shipped configuration
items.behavior: 6 actions from test-struts-config.xml / test-action-servlet.xml are part of the live Struts and Spring configuration: /edit/dataSample, /edit/missingTimeEntryNotification, /edit/putTheClockForward, /edit/properties, /invalidateCache, /invalidateHibernateCache (behaviour in A items below).

items.title: SOAP channel (Apache Axis 1.4)
items.behavior: AxisServlet mapped to /soap/* and /servlet/AxisServlet; server-config.wsdd deploys service XPlanner (class com.technoetic.xplanner.soap.XPlanner, allowedMethods=*) and Version (org.apache.axis.Version.getVersion) with bean mappings for Project/Iteration/UserStory/Task/Feature/TimeEntry/Note/Person data types in namespace http://xplanner.org/soap.

items.title: REST channel (Jersey 1.x) under /rest/*
items.behavior: Jersey SpringServlet with POJO JSON mapping mapped to /rest/*; component scan of net.sf.xplanner.rest registers ViewService (@Path /view) and UpdateService (@Path /update), both request-scoped.

items.title: Spring MVC channel under /setting/*
items.behavior: DispatcherServlet (spring-web.xml, component scan net.sf.xplanner.web, JSP view resolver /WEB-INF/jsp/*.jsp) mapped to /setting/*: MePage @RequestMapping /me/status/{id}; CommonObjectHandler /{objectType}/list and /{objectType}/edit/{objectId}.

items.title: iCalendar feed channel /ical/*
items.behavior: iCalServlet mapped to /ical/* (behaviour in A-item iCal).

items.title: Chart image channel /cewolf/*
items.behavior: Cewolf CewolfRenderer (load-on-startup 1, overlib url, debug=false) mapped to /cewolf/*; renders charts declared by cewolf tags in timesheet.jsp, aggregateTimesheet.jsp and iterationStatistics.jsp.

items.title: Static content and welcome page
items.behavior: Welcome file index.jsp; static images, css, js, calendar, flash (Dashboard.swf, expressInstall.swf), import templates and the file xplanner-plus-activity.log are served from the web root.

items.title: Outbound e-mail channel (SMTP via JavaMail)
items.behavior: EmailMessageImpl builds JavaMail sessions from xplanner.mail.smtp.host/port and optional xplanner.mail.smtp.user/password (mail.smtp.auth, starttls) and sends multipart HTML messages; from address xplanner.mail.from.

items.title: Declared but disabled or unwired channels
items.behavior: JAX-WS endpoint /service/xplanner (sun-jaxws.xml) has its WSServlet and listener commented out; XFire Spring config commented; net.sf.xplanner.dwr.Project exists without any DWR servlet; com.technoetic.xplanner.webservers.JettyServer is a standalone main() launcher not used by the WAR; NullSecurityFilter (auto-login as sysadmin) is commented out.
items.limits: Absence of DWR servlet checked against the full web.xml servlet list

items.title: Servlet filter chain and URL coverage
items.behavior: Declared mappings: ActivityLogFilter /do/*; ServletRequestFilter /* (thread-local request, currentPageUrl/appPath attributes); OpenSessionInViewFilter and HibernateSessionFilter /* (REQUEST, ERROR); MobileSecurityFilter /do/mobile/*; WebSecurityFilter (FormSecurityFilter) /do/* and /setting/*; BasicSecurityFilter /soap/* and /ical/*; RequestCharacterEncodingFilter UTF-8 on /do/* (mapped after the security filters). No security filter covers /rest/*, /cewolf/*, /servlet/AxisServlet or static files.
items.limits: Container filter ordering by mapping order assumed per Servlet 2.4

items.title: Application start-up listeners
items.behavior: Log4jConfigListener (log4j-war.xml, webAppRootKey xplanner-plus.root); HsqldbServerContextListener starts an in-process HSQLDB server only when xplanner.migration.databasetype=hsqldb (effective value mysql, so not started); Spring ContextLoaderListener (spring-beans.xml); RequestContextListener; net.sf.xplanner.context.ContextLoaderListener puts iterationTypes and appUrl (xplanner.application.url) into the servlet context.

items.title: Error handling pages
items.behavior: web.xml maps JspException, ServletException and Throwable to common/unexpectedError.jsp (title, unknown error text, filing instructions built from support.production.email, support.issue.url and error.filingInfo, exception details). Struts global exceptions: ObjectNotFoundException and Hibernate UnresolvableObjectException -> generalError.jsp with error.objectNotFound (object id); AuthorizationException -> generalError.jsp with security.notauthorized. An ExceptionHandler stores uncaught exceptions under the Struts EXCEPTION key.

items.title: Session policy
items.behavior: HTTP session timeout 30 minutes; web application marked distributable; login context and saved URL are kept in the session.

items.title: Per-request activity log
items.behavior: ActivityLogFilter writes START and END lines (time, user id, remote address, action name after /do/, duration, query) for each /do/ request to category ActivityLogFilter -> RollingFileAppender ${xplanner-plus.root}/xplanner-plus-activity.log (5MB x 50) and console. Because the file is written to the web application root and no filter protects static files, it is retrievable by URL (inferred). The WAR also ships a 26,728-byte sample activity log.

items.title: Localization and locale switching
items.behavior: Messages come from ResourceBundle (default English) with da, de, es, fr, it, ja, pt_br, ru variants and ResourceBundle--.properties, via a Spring ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource (UTF-8, no system-locale fallback) bridged to Struts. /do/changeLocale?language=xx&returnto=... stores the chosen Locale in the session (empty language -> default locale) and forwards to returnto or view/projects. E-mail texts use EmailResourceBundle.

items.title: Transaction and persistence wiring
items.behavior: Struts actions based on AbstractAction run doExecute inside CheckedExceptionHandlingTransactionTemplate with beforeObjectCommit/afterObjectCommit hooks; Spring HibernateTransactionManager; @Transactional annotations enabled; DBCP BasicDataSource; AnnotationSessionFactoryBean scanning net.sf.xplanner.domain plus mappings/Metrics.xml only; second-level and query cache via EhCache (diskStore java.io.tmpdir).

items.title: Web form login
items.behavior: GET/POST /do/login (security bypass) with userId, password and a remember checkbox (checked by default) plus optional login.instructions help link. Empty userId -> login form (notAuthenticated). Successful authentication stores the JAAS Subject in the session and redirects to the saved original URL if any, otherwise to /do/view/projects. Failure logs a warning and returns to the form with login.failed plus per-login-module messages (authentication.module.name prefix).

items.title: Remember-me credential cookie
items.behavior: When remember=Y the login stores cookies userid and password; the password cookie value is only Base64-encoded. On later requests without a session, FormSecurityFilter re-authenticates from these cookies; a failed cookie login removes them. Logout removes them.
items.limits: Cookie attributes (path, max-age, secure) in util.CookieSupport not examined in detail

items.title: Unauthenticated request handling for /do/* and /setting/*
items.behavior: FormSecurityFilter: requests not in the bypass list without an authenticated subject (and no valid cookie) are redirected to <context>/do/login; for GET requests the full URL including query is saved in the session for post-login redirect. Bypass list: /do/login, /do/notAuthorized, /do/invalidateHibernateCache.

items.title: Logout
items.behavior: /do/logout: login module logout invalidates the HTTP session, the credential cookies are removed and the user is forwarded to security/login (/do/login). An AOP advisor invalidates the cached permissions of that principal on logout.

items.title: Pluggable login modules and effective configuration
items.behavior: LoginModuleLoader builds the module list from xplanner.security.login[n].module/name/option.*; LoginContext tries each module and collects per-module errors. Effective configuration (xplanner.properties + xplanner-custom.properties) defines only login[0] = XPlannerLoginModule named XPlanner with userIdCaseSensitive=true. Available but not configured: JNDILoginModule (LDAP via com.sabre.security.jndi.JNDIAuthenticatorImpl), NtlmLoginModule (jcifs, default domain YANDEX), JaasLoginModuleAdapter. The LDAP settings in xplanner-custom-apdbuild3/apdbuild6/production.properties are not loaded (loader reads only xplanner.properties and xplanner.overrides, default xplanner-custom.properties). Missing module name -> authentication.module.message.serverConfigurationError.noModuleName.

items.title: XPlanner database password check and password change
items.behavior: XPlannerLoginModule loads the person by userId; unknown user -> authentication.module.message.userNotFound; person without password -> passwordNotSet; the stored value is Base64 of salt plus MD5 digest (MessageDigest MD5 over salt and UTF-8 password); mismatch -> authenticationFailed. changePassword encodes a new salted MD5 hash and commits through the JDBC connection; it is the only module capable of changing passwords (LDAP/NTLM/JAAS throw UnsupportedOperationException).
items.limits: Exact salt length/byte layout not decoded

items.title: HTTP Basic authentication for SOAP and iCal
items.behavior: BasicSecurityFilter on /soap/* and /ical/*: accepts an existing session subject or an Authorization: Basic header decoded as user:password and authenticated through the same Authenticator; on failure responds with WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="XPlanner" and an error status (401 inferred from setStatus call).

items.title: Mobile login and its filter conflict
items.behavior: /do/mobile/login uses AuthenticationAction with WAP login forms (userId, password, remember) and redirects to /do/mobile/view/projects. MobileSecurityFilter bypasses /do/mobile/login, but WebSecurityFilter is also mapped to /do/* and its bypass list does not contain /do/mobile/login, so an unauthenticated mobile user is redirected to the web login first.

items.title: Bootstrap system administrator account
items.behavior: Liquibase change set 1-3 inserts person id 1 (name/userId sysadmin, e-mail no@reply.com, initials SYS) and a person_role row giving role 5 (sysadmin) on project 0 (all projects). README documents sysadmin/admin as default login (documentation only). A separate tk-autopatch patch class BootstrapSystemUser contains a hard-coded password hash constant and would create the same user and permissions, but no autopatch launcher is wired into the web application.
items.limits: Seeded password value not reproduced; whether Liquibase seeds a password column not asserted

items.title: Role hierarchy and project-scoped role assignment
items.behavior: Roles viewer(id 2, lft 1-8) > editor(3, 2-7) > admin(4, 3-6) > sysadmin(5, 4-5) stored as a nested set in table roles (renamed from role by change set 2-5). person_role(person_id, role_id, project_id) assigns a role per project; project_id 0 means all projects (security.roles query includeWildcardProject).

items.title: Seeded permission matrix
items.behavior: permission rows: sysadmin % on % (allow all); editor create%, edit%, integrate%, delete% on % (allow); viewer read% on % (allow); admin admin% on % (allow); negatives: editor create.project (system.project), editor create.person (system.person), editor delete on system.project.iteration, admin create.project. Evaluation (security.role.permissions): a person gets positive permissions of its role and all weaker ancestor roles, but negative permissions only of its own role. Effective: viewer = read; editor = read/create/edit/integrate/delete except creating projects/people and deleting iterations; admin = editor rights + admin.* (incl. admin.edit.role, admin.hide, admin.edit) and may delete iterations/create people but not create projects; sysadmin = everything. Personal permissions (principal = person id) are also supported.
items.limits: Wildcard matching semantics of % inferred from isMatching string constant

items.title: Resource types used in permission checks
items.behavior: AuthorizerImpl maps classes to resource types: Project system.project; Iteration system.project.iteration; UserStory system.project.iteration.story; Task system.project.iteration.story.task; Feature system.project.iteration.story.feature; TimeEntry system.project.iteration.story.task.time_entry; Integration system.project.integration; Person system.person; Note system.note; Setting system.setting; editor forms map to their domain types.

items.title: Where permissions are enforced on the server
items.behavior: Call sites of Authorizer.hasPermission: DispatchForward (read on system.project when the mapping has an @secure forward; missing projectId -> error action.missing.parameter, denied -> security/notAuthorized); RepositorySecurityAdapter (load=read, update=edit, delete=delete) inside metaRepository; SOAP XPlanner per operation; iCal servlet; content search result filter (read); AggregateTimesheetQuery; EditRoleAction and EditPersonHelper (admin.edit.role on the project); IterationRepository.canUserEditIteration and UserStoryRepository.accept (choice lists); OutlineTag navigation; projects.jsp list filter (read). JSP tags isUserAuthorized/isUserAuthorizedForAny only hide or show UI controls.
items.limits: Call graph from own bytecode scan (invoke opcodes); reflection/JSP scriptlets outside scan

items.title: URL role constraints are parsed but not enforced
items.behavior: security.xml, mobile-security.xml and soap-security.xml declare security-constraints with role names (web and SOAP use "*"; mobile lists viewer/editor/admin). SecurityConfiguration.isAuthorized has no caller in the bytecode; AbstractSecurityFilter.doFilter only checks the bypass list and authentication. So URL constraints enforce "authenticated" only; the mobile role list has no effect.
items.limits: Negative (no caller) verified with a positive control: the same scan finds the isSecureRequest caller

items.title: Generic view/edit/delete actions have no server-side permission check
items.behavior: ViewObjectAction, EditObjectAction (and subclasses) and DeleteObjectAction load, save and delete through CommonDao (Hibernate Session) without calling Authorizer; permissions such as admin.edit (edit project) or sysadmin.delete (delete project) are applied only by JSP button tags. /view/person and /view/people and /view/projects are configured authorizationRequired=false. An authenticated user can therefore invoke these URLs directly regardless of role.
items.limits: Runtime not exercised; Hibernate interceptors/AOP around CommonDao not found in configuration

items.title: Channels reachable without authentication
items.behavior: /rest/* (ViewService GET project and iteration stories; UpdateService POST task status), /cewolf/* chart images, /servlet/AxisServlet (second Axis mapping, outside BasicSecurityFilter) and static files have no security filter. REST UpdateManager changes task status without any permission check. SOAP calls through /servlet/AxisServlet reach XPlanner.hasPermission, which needs a remote user (likely failing with an authentication fault).

items.title: Permission caching and invalidation
items.behavior: Results of getAllPermissions, getAllPermissionsToPerson and getPermissionsForPrincipal are cached in an in-memory map by AOP interceptors; the cache for a principal is invalidated on logout and all related caches on EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles; /do/invalidateCache clears the whole map.

items.title: Hidden projects and hidden people
items.behavior: Project and Person have an is_hidden flag. The project list shows the hidden column only to users with hide permission on any project; index.jsp and other lists query hidden=false. The people list shows hidden people only with admin.hide on system.person; the hide selector in the person editor needs hide permission; the project editor has a hidden field.

items.title: Not-authorized page is missing
items.behavior: Global forward security/notAuthorized points to /WEB-INF/jsp/security/notAuthorized.jsp, which is not in the WAR; DispatchForward and ImportPeopleAction forward to it on denial, so denial ends in a container error instead of a message.

items.title: Home redirect (index.jsp)
items.behavior: The welcome page counts non-hidden projects: 0 or more than 1 -> redirect /do/view/projects; exactly 1 -> redirect to its current iteration /do/view/iteration?oid=<id>, or to the project list if it has no current iteration. index.jsp is also in the view constraint list (authentication only).

items.title: Project list
items.behavior: /do/view/projects: all projects ordered by hidden flag and name, filtered to those the user may read; columns id, name, current iteration link, hidden (if hide permission); per-row edit (admin.edit) and delete (sysadmin.delete, with confirmation) buttons; links Add project (create.project), People, Aggregate timesheet; empty list -> projects.none.

items.title: View project and project features
items.behavior: /do/view/project?oid: description, iteration table (id, name, start, end, days worked, story count) with edit/delete actions, iterations.none when empty, project actions, Create iteration (create on system.project.iteration), People (read system.person), History, export links. /do/view/project/features lists features of the project with edit/delete and admin links.

items.title: Create/edit project
items.behavior: /do/edit/project: fields name, description, hidden, wiki URL (project attribute twiki.scheme.wiki, default http://), send e-mail notifications (attribute xplanner.project.send.notification, default true), escape brackets (xplanner.escape.brackets); Create or Update action; missing name -> project.editor.missing_name. Notification receivers are added/removed with addTimeNotification/delTimeNotification, forwarded to /do/edit/project/notification (UpdateTimeNotificationReceivers: unknown action -> ServletException).

items.title: Delete project and other objects (generic delete)
items.behavior: /do/delete/project|iteration|feature|userstory|task|person?oid: DeleteObjectAction loads the object, publishes an ObjectDeleted event, deletes it and redirects to returnto or view/projects. UI confirmation via action.delete.confirmation.
items.limits: Cascade behaviour of child rows unverified

items.title: Export project (XML, MPX, MSPDI)
items.behavior: /do/export/project/xml|mpx|mspdi?oid: ExportAction with XmlExporter (text/xml export.xml, Betwixt, password and lastUpdateTime hidden), MpxExporter (application/mpx export.mpx) or MspdiExporter (application/mspdi export.xml); export failures raise ExportException. Available formats listed from xplanner.export.formats when a matching action exists.

items.title: View iteration (stories)
items.behavior: /do/view/iteration?oid: stories table with edit/delete/move-continue actions, stories.none when empty, Save order (/do/edit/reorderstories), Move multiple (/do/move/userstories), links to tasks, features, dashboard, metrics, statistics, accuracy and history; iteration actions Create story, Start, Close, Import stories; progress bar (xplanner.progressbar.impl=html).

items.title: Reorder stories
items.behavior: /do/edit/reorderstories: ReorderStoriesForm with order numbers; invalid order -> story.editor.invalid.order.number and redisplay iteration.jsp; success redirect to /do/view/iteration?oid=.

items.title: Create/edit iteration
items.behavior: /do/edit/iteration: name, description, start/end dates, days worked, project; validation iteration.editor.missing_name, bad_start_date, bad_end_date; on Create the project, initial status and days worked are set before commit.

items.title: Start iteration
items.behavior: /do/start/iteration: confirmation page (editIterationStatus.jsp) listing already started iterations of the project with an option to close them; confirm -> iteration started, opening data samples generated, history event started; optional saveTime wizard forwards to /do/edit/time to re-estimate before starting.

items.title: Close iteration and continue unfinished stories
items.behavior: /do/close/iteration: sets the iteration inactive, generates closing data samples, records history closed and redirects to /do/continue/unfinished/stories. There the user picks a target iteration; Ok continues every incomplete story into the target (StoryContinuer clones, continued descriptions and notes, history continued); Cancel does nothing; same source and target -> iteration.status.editor.continue_in_same_iteration.

items.title: Iteration tasks, features, metrics, statistics and accuracy views
items.behavior: /do/view/iteration/tasks (all tasks), /features, /metrics (ViewIterationMetricsAction; hours worked per developer via iterationHoursWorkedQuery, Unassigned bucket), /statistics (pie charts by task type and disposition for count/estimated/actual hours, velocity charts, burn-down from datasample; chart size and velocity visibility from xplanner.effort.chart.*), /accuracy (estimate accuracy with pie charts).

items.title: Export iteration, story, task and person
items.behavior: /do/export/iteration/xml|mpx|mspdi|pdf|jrpdf, /do/export/userstory/pdf|jrpdf, /do/export/task/pdf|jrpdf, /do/export/person/jrpdf. pdf = iText story/task cards (application/pdf export.pdf); jrpdf = JasperReports (report.pdf) compiled from com/technoetic/xplanner/export/reports/JR*.jrxml, which are not present anywhere in the WAR or its jars, so jrpdf exports are expected to fail. CsvExporter exists but is not configured.
items.limits: Absence of .jrxml verified by listing the WAR and all 102 jars with a positive control

items.title: Import stories from a spreadsheet
items.behavior: /do/import/stories?oid=<iteration>: upload .xls with worksheet name (default Features), column headers for title, iteration end date, estimate, priority and status, completed status marker (default C) and only-incomplete option; header settings remembered in cookies. Errors: no file, worksheet name/title/end date/priority/completed status missing (form validation), corrupted file, missing required field (story name), wrong header, worksheet not found. Template download files/storiesImportTemplate.xls.

items.title: Iteration dashboard (task board)
items.behavior: /do/view/dashboard: board with columns not started / in progress / done filled by jQuery from GET <appPath>rest/view/iteration/${param.fkey}/userstories (tasks with originalEstimate 0 -> not started, completed -> done, otherwise in progress); tasks can be dragged between columns only in the browser (no call persists the move). The iteration link passes iterationId while the page reads param.fkey.
items.limits: Whether xplanner:link adds fkey not verified; runtime unverified

items.title: Delete iteration restrictions
items.behavior: Delete iteration is offered by action buttons with permission delete; editors hold a negative delete permission on system.project.iteration so the button is hidden for them, admins and sysadmins see it. The action mapping references an undefined form iterationEditorForm.

items.title: View user story
items.behavior: /do/view/userstory?oid: customer, tracker, estimated/actual/remaining hours, disposition, status, last update, tasks with edit/delete/move-continue/edit-time actions, features, Create task, History, export links; story.no_tasks / story.no_features when empty.

items.title: Create/edit user story
items.behavior: /do/edit/userstory: name, description, iteration, tracker, customer, estimated hours, priority (default xplanner.story.defaultpriority=4), status, disposition (derived from iteration via determineNewStoryDisposition), order number; errors story.editor.missing_name, negative_estimated_hours, invalid_priority, same_iteration; changing the iteration re-orders stories of the target iteration.

items.title: Move or continue a story
items.behavior: /do/move/continue/userstory: Move puts the story into another iteration (history moved, moved out, moved in); Continue copies the unfinished part into the target iteration with continue.description.* texts; errors story.editor.missing_name, story.editor.same_iteration; unknown action -> ServletException.

items.title: Move several stories
items.behavior: /do/move/userstories: select stories by checkbox and a target iteration; Move -> redirect /do/view/iteration?oid=<source>.

items.title: Features of a story
items.behavior: /do/view/feature, /do/edit/feature (name, description; feature.editor.missing_name), /do/delete/feature. Their Spring beans declare type net.sf.xplanner.domain.Feature, a class that does not exist; the real com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Feature is not an annotated entity and mappings/Feature.xml is not loaded. Feature screens are therefore expected to fail.

items.title: View task, complete and reopen
items.behavior: /do/view/task?oid: acceptor, estimated/actual hours, created date, time log table (report date, start, end, duration, pair, description), History, export links; a Complete button (posts /do/edit/task action=Update completed=true) or Reopen button (completed=false).

items.title: Create/edit task and notification e-mail
items.behavior: /do/edit/task: name, description, type, disposition (new-task disposition of the iteration), acceptor, estimated hours, created date, completed; errors format.date/task.editor.bad_created_date, task.editor.missing_name, task.editor.negative_estimated_hours. After a submitted save, EditTaskAction.sendNotification composes a task created / task updated e-mail (velocity templates email_notification_task_created.vm / _updated.vm, subjects task.created.subject / task.updated.subject) comparing old and new acceptor ("Unassigned" when none).
items.limits: Exact recipient set and project notification gating inferred

items.title: Move or continue a task
items.behavior: /do/move/continue/task (session-scoped form): Move to another story (history task.moved.from.to / moved out / moved in) or Continue into another story; error task.editor.same_story; failure -> ServletException error during task move/continue action.

items.title: Task estimate page
items.behavior: /do/edit/task/estimate is bound to the plain Struts Action (no behaviour) with an undefined form name; editTaskEstimate.jsp posts the estimate to /do/edit/time.

items.title: Enter and edit time entries
items.behavior: /do/edit/time?oid=<task>: rows with report date, start time, end time or duration, person 1, person 2 (pair), description, delete flag, plus remaining hours. Errors: edittime.error.unparsable_time, unparsable_number, missing_time, missing_person, same_people, negative_interval, overlapping_interval, both_interval_and_duration, missing_report_date, long_description. Success redirects to /do/view/task; error redisplays the editor.

items.title: Re-estimate tasks when starting an iteration
items.behavior: UpdateTimeAction UPDATE_ESTIMATE saves the form in the session during the start-iteration wizard, records history reestimated ("Estimate changed from x to y") and returns to /do/start/iteration.

items.title: Person timesheet
items.behavior: /do/view/timesheet?oid=<person>: start/end date range; totals per project, iteration and story with pie charts; unparsable date -> timesheet.error.unparsable_date.

items.title: Aggregate timesheet
items.behavior: /do/view/aggregateTimesheet: choose people (non-hidden, ordered by name) and a date range; per-project permission check in AggregateTimesheetQuery; totals and pie charts by project, iteration and story; unparsable date error.

items.title: iCalendar export of tasks and time
items.behavior: GET /ical/<userId>.ics with Basic auth: path missing -> "No iCal file requested."; missing .ics -> "No .ics suffix ..."; another person's calendar requires admin.edit on system.person for some project, else "No authorization for accessing calendar for ..."; output is a VCALENDAR with VTODO items for incomplete, non-overhead tasks accepted by the person and VEVENT items for that person's time entries (as person 1 or 2), each with a URL to do/view/task?oid; content type application/x-msoutlook.

items.title: People list
items.behavior: /do/view/people (no action-level authorization): people ordered by name (hidden included only for admin.hide), links Add person (create.person) and Import people.

items.title: View person
items.behavior: /do/view/person?oid (authorizationRequired=false): contact info (mailto e-mail, phone), current active, pending and completed tasks, future tasks, stories where the person is customer or tracker, timesheet link, export links.

items.title: Create/edit person, roles and password
items.behavior: /do/edit/person: name, user id, initials, e-mail, phone, hidden (hide), new password + confirmation (only when the login module can change passwords), per-project role none/viewer/editor/admin (shown per project where the user has admin.edit.role), system administrator flag (sysadmin.promote). Errors person.editor.missing_name, missing_user_id, missing_email, missing_initials, password_mismatch; duplicate user id -> person.editor.userid_exist on the editor page. Roles are modified before commit (EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles, cache invalidation); the password is changed after commit through the login module.

items.title: Edit project roles
items.behavior: /do/edit/roles (session-scoped RoleEditorForm, type Project): assign persons to roles on a project; EditRoleAction checks admin.edit.role on the project before commit and replaces the person_role rows.

items.title: Import people
items.behavior: /do/import/people: upload a text file read line by line and split on commas into 5 fields (user id, name, e-mail, initials, phone); each line gets a result: people.import.status.success, wrong_entry_format, empty_userId or userId_exists. The downloadable template is an .xls file although the parser reads comma-separated text.

items.title: My status page (Me link)
items.behavior: Header link Me -> ${appUrl}/setting/me/status/<person id>: meStatus.jsp with the person's current active/pending/completed tasks, future tasks, customer and tracker stories. The id comes from the URL with no ownership check. appUrl is xplanner.application.url (http://localhost:8080/xplanner from xplanner-custom.properties), which does not match the deployed context path.
items.limits: Link target mismatch not observed live

items.title: Notes and attachments
items.behavior: notes.jsp (included by the view layouts) lists notes attached to an object with edit/delete and download links. /do/edit/note: subject, body, author, attachedToId, optional file upload stored in the database file system under /attachments/project/<projectId>; errors note.editor.missing_subject, missing_author, missing_body. /do/delete/note deletes via DeleteNoteAction (delete event). /do/download/attachment?oid streams the file with its content type and Content-disposition filename.

items.title: File manager
items.behavior: /do/view/directory: list, upload, download, delete file, mkdir and rmdir in the database-backed directory tree (xdir/xfile); unknown object -> error/objectNotFound.

items.title: Content search
items.behavior: Header search form -> /do/search/content with searchedContent and restrictToProjectId: empty text -> error "missing content"; a numeric text is resolved as an id (invalid -> contentsearch.invalid_id); text search over projects, iterations, stories, tasks and notes, restricted to the current project unless search.content.globalScopeEnable=true; results filtered by read permission and shown in searchResults.jsp.

items.title: Search by id
items.behavior: /do/search/id?searchedId: missing -> idsearch.error.missingId; non-numeric -> idsearch.error.badId; unknown -> idsearch.error.idNotFound; found -> redirect /do/view/<type>?oid=<id>.

items.title: Object history
items.behavior: /do/view/history?oid&@type[&container=true]: history events for an object or its container (created, updated, deleted, moved, continued, started, closed, reestimated), newest first, with person links. Events are recorded by RepositoryHistoryAdapter and by the actions listed.

items.title: Wiki-style text formatting
items.behavior: Descriptions are rendered by TwikiFormat: <verbatim>/<pre> blocks, bracket escaping (xplanner.escape.brackets), scheme links sourceforge/cvs/jira/wiki/cq and object links project:/iteration:/story:/task: to /do/view/<type>?oid, external wiki topic links via GenericWikiAdapter (localhost:9090 URLs). Help page /do/view/twikiformat.

items.title: Continuous-integration queue
items.behavior: /do/view/integrations and /do/edit/integrations?projectId: join the queue (person, comment; no person -> integrations.error.noperson), leave, start (already active -> integrations.error.alreadyactive), finish, cancel; listeners from xplanner.integration.listeners (IntegrationEmailNotifier mails the next person a link /do/view/integrations?projectId=). Its queries use com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Integration, which is not a mapped entity (the mapped one is net.sf.xplanner.domain.Integration), so the feature is expected to fail.

items.title: Settings list and editor
items.behavior: /do/view/settings lists Setting entities (edit admin.edit, delete sysadmin.delete, Add setting with create.project). /do/edit/setting (EditObjectAction on Setting) has input page editSetting.jsp, which is missing. Settings have scope Global/Project/Group/User and an object type; object types User, Project, Iteration, UserStory, Task, Note, Setting are seeded.

items.title: System information page
items.behavior: /do/systemInfo renders unexpectedError.jsp in system-info mode: build (version, date, revision, package), database (dialect, driver, vendor/version, URL, user, password masked), application server, JVM and OS properties.

items.title: Reload Tiles definitions
items.behavior: /do/admin/reload-tiles runs Struts ReloadDefinitionsAction for any authenticated user.

items.title: Generic object list/edit handler (Spring MVC)
items.behavior: /setting/{objectType}/list and /setting/{objectType}/edit/{objectId} only print to standard output and return a view name; no data behaviour.

items.title: Run data sampling on demand
items.behavior: /do/edit/dataSample executes txDataSamplingCommand (samples estimated/actual/remaining hours of iterations to sample) and forwards to returnto or view/projects.

items.title: Send missing-time notifications on demand
items.behavior: /do/edit/missingTimeEntryNotification executes MissingTimeEntryNotifier immediately.

items.title: Shift the application clock
items.behavior: /do/edit/putTheClockForward?dayOffset=N moves the TimeGenerator current day by N days (reset when parameter absent) for all time-dependent logic.

items.title: Change runtime properties
items.behavior: /do/edit/properties?propertyName&propertyValue sets any XPlannerProperties value in memory for the running application.

items.title: Clear permission cache
items.behavior: /do/invalidateCache clears the permission method cache ("cache cleared"); input page admin/invalidateCache.jsp missing.

items.title: Evict Hibernate query cache without login
items.behavior: /do/invalidateHibernateCache calls SessionFactory.evictQueries ("hibernate cache cleared") and is in the security bypass list, so it works without authentication.

items.title: Mobile read-only navigation
items.behavior: WAP pages: projects (non-hidden), project (details, current and other iterations), iteration (stories), story (tasks), task, person (phone call link wtai://). Objects are loaded directly by oid through db:useBean. Links are hard-coded to /xplanner/do/mobile/..., which does not match the /xplanner-plus or /xplanner-legacy context paths. wap/auth.jsp is a debug page echoing cookie, userId and password, placed under WEB-INF and linked as /xplanner/wap/auth.jsp (unreachable).

items.title: SOAP XPlanner service operations
items.behavior: 43 public operations (exhaustive list in appendix.soapOperations): get/add/update/remove for Project, Iteration, UserStory, Task, TimeEntry, Note, Person; getProjects, getIterations(project), getCurrentIteration(project), getUserStories(iteration), getTasks(story), getCurrentTasksForPerson, getPlannedTasksForPerson, getTimeEntries(task), getNotesForObject, getPeople; attribute get/set/delete/list/prefix list. Reads filter to readable objects; create/update/delete check create/edit/delete permission and fail with "no permission to ... object"; changes write history events; the session is committed or rolled back per call.

items.title: Axis global configuration
items.behavior: server-config.wsdd sets adminPassword=admin, an attachments directory on a Windows developer path, JWS handlers for .jws/.jwr (no JWS files in the WAR), URLMapper and HTTPAuthHandler on the HTTP transport; SimpleAuthenticationHandler is declared but not in any chain; AdminService is not deployed.

items.title: REST read endpoints
items.behavior: GET /rest/view -> text/plain greeting (getIt); GET /rest/view/project/{projectId} -> ProjectView (id, name) as XML or JSON; GET /rest/view/iteration/{iterationId}/userstories -> list of UserStoryView (priority, id, name, description, trackerId, estimatedHours, orderNo, status, tasks with name, id, completed, description, createdDate, originalEstimate, estimatedHours, acceptorId).

items.title: REST task status update
items.behavior: POST /rest/update/task/{taskId}/status (form: status, originalEstimate) -> Result(error, code, description): unknown task -> "Task not found"; status equal to current -> "Task status not changed"; NON_STARTED -> "Moving Task to not started not implemented"; otherwise sets original estimate and completed flag (COMPLETED -> true) and saves -> "Task updated". No authentication or permission check.
items.limits: Exact branch order inferred from constant order

items.title: Daily missing-time-entry e-mails
items.behavior: Spring task scheduler (pool 10) runs missingTimeEntryNotifier.execute with cron 0 5 0 * * * (00:05 every day): acceptors of incomplete tasks in active iterations (status 0) whose last time entry is older than the cutoff get a reminder (job.emailnotifier.subjectForAcceptors) if the project sends notifications; project notification receivers get a summary per acceptor (job.emailnotifier.subjectForProjectLeeds).

items.title: Burn-down data sampling job is defined but not scheduled
items.behavior: datasamplingJob (Quartz JobDetailBean -> DataSamplingJob -> txDataSamplingCommand) and datasamplingTrigger (cron 0 55 23 ? 1-12 *) are defined, but the Quartz SchedulerFactoryBean that would register the trigger is commented out. Samples are therefore produced only when an iteration is started or closed and through /do/edit/dataSample. The sampler can extend iteration end dates when iteration.automatically.extend.endDate=true (effective false).
items.limits: No other Quartz scheduler found by class/call scan (positive control DataSamplingJob found)

items.title: Domain change events without listeners
items.behavior: EventManager publishes ObjectCreated/ObjectUpdated/ObjectDeleted Spring events from edit/delete actions. EmailPerChangeListener/EmailHelper would send per-change e-mails, but they are neither declared in XML nor in a component-scanned package, so the events have no effect.

items.title: Automatic database schema creation and seeding at start-up
items.behavior: SpringLiquibase runs db-changelog.xml (contexts test, production) before the Hibernate session factory: creates all tables when attribute/object_type tables are absent, adds keys and indexes, seeds roles, permissions, patches row (level 14), identifier, sysadmin person and role, object types, adds columns, renames role to roles. tk-autopatch (xplanner.migration.patchpath) is configured but not started by the web application.

items.title: HSQLDB in-process server (conditional)
items.behavior: HsqlServer can start a public HSQLDB server and registers a shutdown hook when the database type is hsqldb and a local hsql URL with xplanner.hsqldb.server.database is configured; not active with the effective MySQL configuration.

items.title: Database dependency
items.behavior: MySQL (driver com.mysql.jdbc.Driver, mysql-connector-java-5.1.13, XPlannerMySQLDialect: TINYINT(1) booleans, DATETIME); commons-dbcp pool; hibernate.dbcp.* keys have no consumer (Spring BasicDataSource used). Alternatives shipped: HSQLDB 2.2.4, XPlannerOracleDialect. Validation query select * from identifier is not wired.
items.limits: Consumer search for hibernate.dbcp keys covered classes and JSPs only

items.title: Mail server dependency
items.behavior: SMTP localhost:25 (xplanner.mail.smtp.host/port), sender xplanner@xplannerplus.org, optional SMTP auth; e-mails include CSS fetched over HTTP from xplanner.application.url/css/email.css by util.HttpClient.

items.title: Directory services (not configured)
items.behavior: LDAP via JNDI (com.sabre.security.jndi), Windows NTLM via jcifs-1.0.1 and generic JAAS modules are available as optional login modules only.

items.title: Configured external URLs
items.behavior: xplanner.application.url (http://localhost:8080/xplanner after override) is used for e-mail links, iCal URLs and the header Me link; wiki schemes point to sourceforge, codehaus JIRA, c2 wiki, localhost:9090 and an internal ClearQuest URL; support.issue.url points to SourceForge.

items.title: Third-party libraries (server)
items.behavior: 102 jars (exhaustive list in appendix.jars), notably Struts 1.2.9, Spring 3.0.5, Hibernate 3.6.5 (+annotations, JPA 2.0 API), Liquibase 2.0.1, Axis 1.4, Jersey 1.1.5/1.5 with Jackson 1.7.4, Quartz 1.5.2, Velocity 1.5 and velocity-dep 1.4, JavaMail 1.4.3, iText 1.01, JasperReports 1.0.2, MPXJ 3.0.1, POI 3.5, JFreeChart 1.0.11 + Cewolf 1.0, displaytag 1.0, Sitemesh 2.2.1, EhCache 1.2.3, jcifs, HSQLDB 2.2.4, MySQL connector 5.1.13, Jetty 5.1.10 and start-6.1.17. Duplicate versions present: commons-beanutils 1.6.1 and 1.7.0, velocity 1.5 and velocity-dep 1.4, jakarta-oro 2.0.6 and oro 2.0.8.

items.title: Client-side libraries and assets
items.behavior: jQuery 1.5.1, jQuery UI 1.8.11, jqote2, Dojo (cross-domain build) and dojox charting theme, swfobject with flash/Dashboard.swf, overlib, calendar widget (en, fr, it, ro), nifty, tooltip, global.js, iteration.js, editTimeEntries.js, toggle.js, time.js.
items.limits: Use of Dashboard.swf by any JSP not found (grep for swf)

items.title: Persistent entities and tables
items.behavior: 21 JPA entities mapped (exhaustive list with columns in appendix.entities): project, iteration, story, task, time_entry, person, roles, person_role, permission, note, xfile, xdir, history, attribute, datasample, identifier, integration, notification_receivers, object_type, setting (single-table inheritance on object_type), patches. Legacy hbm files mappings/*.xml other than Metrics.xml are not loaded.

items.title: Named HQL queries
items.behavior: 29 active named queries in mappings/Metrics.xml (two further query elements at lines 21 and 32 sit inside an XML comment; security, search, restricted search, current/editable iteration, notes, tasks current/planned, notification queries, stories customer/tracker, hours worked); exhaustive list in appendix.namedQueries.

items.title: Domain vocabularies
items.behavior: TaskStatus NON_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED; IterationType REGULAR, BACKLOG (projects have an optional backlog iteration, column backlog_id); SettingScope Global, Project, Group, User; story/task dispositions and statuses from domain classes StoryDisposition, TaskDisposition, IterationStatus.

items.title: Identifier generation
items.behavior: IDs come from table identifier (nextId, seeded 19) through a TableHiLo generator.

items.title: Struts references to missing files
items.behavior: Forwards or inputs pointing to files absent from the WAR: /WEB-INF/jsp/view/iterationTabs.jsp (/view/iterationTabs), iterationIterations.jsp (global view/iteration/statistics), taskhistory.jsp, viewtext.jsp, /images/calendar.png, security/notAuthorized.jsp, edit/editSetting.jsp, admin/invalidateCache.jsp. Generated mechanically (appendix.strutsChecks).
items.limits: Positive control: existing forward view/projects resolves

items.title: Struts actions with undefined form beans
items.behavior: Action name attributes without a form-bean definition: iterationEditorForm (/delete/iteration), featureEditorForm (/delete/feature), userStoryEditorForm (/delete/userstory), edit/task/estimate, /download/attachment, edit/properties.
items.limits: Runtime effect (form ignored vs error) unverified

items.title: Unused property override files
items.behavior: xplanner-custom-apdbuild3, -apdbuild6, -before-standalone-install-backup, -production, -standalone-install, -template and -war-install .properties are shipped but never loaded; some contain LDAP, HSQLDB and company-specific settings and credentials.

items.title: Dead or unwired code paths
items.behavior: CsvExporter (no action), MissingTimeEntryEmailJob (no trigger), OLDIdSearchHelper, TransformingSchemaExport, XPlannerInterceptor (not set on the session factory), HibernateHelper legacy session factory (bean commented), DWR Project, JettyServer.
